title: How to Build a Project Management Tool Without Code
summary: Build a custom project management tool with AI in hours. No Jira per-seat fees, no config. Database, auth, and hosting included. Full-stack from day one.
body_markdown: Yes, via CSV export. Export your Jira backlog, then describe the import: "Create a CSV import page for tasks. Map \[Summary, Assignee, Status, Priority, Due Date\] columns to our task fields and import each row as a task in the selected project." Blink generates the import UI and the backend parser in the same session.
